text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
After school, while visiting the library 
to search for training reference 
materials—

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: ...Fufu.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I spotted Zenno Rob Roy, looking unusually 
captivated by her book.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: Ah... You mean this book?

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
"Definitive Collection of Western Heroic 
Tales"— It's actually one of my absolute 
favorites.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: Yes... um. ...Are you interested?

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
Wah... I'm so glad! Heroic tales are truly 
wonderful!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
—Nobody started out magnificent from the 
beginning. There were plenty of heroes who 
were once completely unknown.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
Yet... step by step, they grew stronger. 
Overcoming countless trials and hardships—

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
And in the end...! They became figures 
commanding the rapt attention of everyone 
around them...!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
...So, whenever I read such dramatic 
stories, I think... I want to become like 
that too.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
Even though I'm shy and inconspicuous 
right now... Someday, I want to stand in 
the spotlight like a true hero...!!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: ...That is why—
choice_data_list: You really look up to heroes.
You really look up to heroes.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: —Ah. I-I'm so sorry...!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
I got carried away in the heat of the 
moment... and ended up doing all the 
talking.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
So... um. What brings you to the library 
today?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I told Zenno Rob Roy that I had come to 
look for training reference materials.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
I see... If it wouldn't be an imposition, 
though...

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
To thank you for listening to me, please 
let me lend a hand...!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
I am a library committee member, after 
all... so I'd like to think I'm fairly 
well-versed with the collection here...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Afterward, I spent some time reading 
through the books chosen together with 
Zenno Rob Roy...

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
Oh, right... Before we wrap up, allow me 
to share one episode from this heroic 
tale.
choice_data_list: Heroic tales can serve as reference too?

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
Yes, definitely. This hero, you see, did 
something astonishing—

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
He tied a rope between himself and a 
gigantic bull, training his body through a 
contest of pulling strength.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, it truly is. It just overflows with 
sheer vigor and fortitude.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
I also keep that fighting spirit in mind 
whenever I tackle my own training.
choice_data_list: You're really giving it your all.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: ...Yes!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
Even if I'm completely unknown right 
now... Just like those heroes, one day, 
without fail—

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
I intend to deliver a story... a race, 
where I am the main character...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
As she spoke those words, Zenno Rob Roy's 
eyes shone with an unmistakable, 
unyielding resolve...
